lead.headline: 339 of Atlantic City's 1,473 public housing units sit empty without an approved reason: 23%, 5.9 times similar authorities
lead.number: 339 "regular" vacancies of 1,473 units (23.0%) in HUD's July 2025 file: highest of 91 non-"Moving to Work" authorities with 1,000-4,999 units, 5.9x their 3.9% median; almost half at Stanley Holmes Village, 50% occupied
lead.watch_out: A $450K Choice Neighborhoods grant (FY2021) means units held empty for redevelopment aren't ruled out; setting Stanley Holmes aside, 12% of the rest are still regular vacancies (3.8x peers)
